pageintro.overview.what: Fleet-wide network health at-a-glance overview dashboard
pageintro.overview.features: Summary KPIs (reliability, cost, DNS, concentration) · Traffic/retransmission/timeout/RTT tiles · Synced traffic & error-rate charts · Top cost talkers · Collection status & agent coverage
pageintro.topology.what: Interactive Pod-to-Pod network topology view (force-graph + adjacency matrix)
pageintro.topology.features: graph/matrix view toggle · namespace/AZ/cluster node grouping · min-traffic edge filtering · tunable retransmission health thresholds · edge click for hop-path detail
pageintro.network.what: Source→destination pair-level network traffic analytics view
pageintro.network.features: source/destination scope selection · switchable metrics (volume, throughput, retransmissions, RTT) · namespace/category facet filtering · sortable pair table with inline sparklines · row drill-down to Flows/Topology
pageintro.flows.what: Raw pod-to-pod flow record explorer with filtering
pageintro.flows.features: bucket/monitor/namespace·pod scope filters · top talkers · category traffic mix · activity stream graph · sortable flow table + CSV export
pageintro.paths.what: Hop-by-hop path inspector between a chosen pod pair
pageintro.paths.features: Pod-pair or deep-link path selection · per-hop latency & retransmit breakdown (HopPath) · popular-paths suggestions from top traffic edges · session-scoped recent-lookups history · overall RTT distribution & sortable hop-type composition list
pageintro.insights.what: Tabbed hub for network cost, reliability, latency, dependency, and DNS insights
pageintro.insights.features: Cost & efficiency breakdown · Retransmission & latency anomaly detection · Service dependency mapping · DNS resolution insights · SLO scorecard & top movers
pageintro.workload.what: A workload-insights dashboard reproducing the NFM console's top-contributors rankings
pageintro.workload.features: flow-category filter · per-metric (data transferred · retransmissions · timeouts) top-8 ranked lists · sortable full contributors table · text search filter · snapshot as-of timestamp
pageintro.monitors.what: Per-monitor status and traffic summary card list
pageintro.monitors.features: NHI status badge · retransmission/timeout health chips · window traffic total · DataTransferred sparkline · link to per-monitor detail page
pageintro.history.what: Athena-backed ad-hoc query over the long-range S3/Parquet flow archive
pageintro.history.features: custom date-range query · monitor/namespace/metric filters · on-demand run (fires only on click) · sortable results table · scanned-bytes readout
pageintro.alerts.what: Unified dashboard for CloudWatch alarm states and derived anomaly events
pageintro.alerts.features: Alarm state monitoring · Derived event feed (NHI, reliability, collection gaps, retrans/timeout spikes) · Severity labeling · Composite-condition detection · Live polling
pageintro.anomalies.what: Baseline-deviation anomaly detection dashboard across service entities
pageintro.anomalies.features: Retrans/timeout rate threshold exceedance (events per GB) · window-over-window spike detection (current > σ × prior) · severity (critical/warn) badges and per-kind counts · row-select detail slide-over with topology/network deep links · thresholds and σ configurable via Settings page
pageintro.diagnose.features: Diagnosis over topology, collection status & top anomalies · Streamed Bedrock (Sonnet) markdown output · Regenerate with a different analytical angle · Model & elapsed-time metadata
pageintro.agents.what: Dashboard tracking NFM agent deployment coverage across EKS and standalone nodes
pageintro.agents.features: tagged/policy-attached rate gauges · sortable standalone agent table · collection-cycle history sparkline · last-cycle collection status · EKS vs standalone node counts
pageintro.cost.what: Cost explorer estimating billed USD from NFM traffic bytes
pageintro.cost.features: windowed total cost · monthly run-rate projection · cost ranked by cluster/namespace/monitor · cost-by-category donut · savings recommendations · billed-cost trend
pageintro.reports.features: KPI summary (traffic · retransmissions · timeouts · latency) · top talkers · anomaly list · cost basis & by-category cost breakdown · Markdown/CSV download and print-to-PDF
pageintro.search.what: Unified entity search across pods, services, nodes, IPs, and domains
pageintro.search.features: Debounced query input · unified search across topology, flow, and DNS sources · results grouped by entity type (pod, service, node, subnet, IP, domain) · deep links to the relevant page
pageintro.settings.what: Personalization page for tuning dashboard defaults and alert thresholds
pageintro.settings.features: Default time range · monitor scope · retransmission/timeout thresholds · cost per GB · anomaly sensitivity (σ) · SNS alarm subscribe command copy
